population_definition: all kernels in shard FV-PROPFLOOR-SHARD-B24-1, enumerated below by kernel id and spec digest
independence_sentence: Each item listed was reviewed and attested independently; the single signature is a mechanical convenience over the enumerated digests, not a bulk review.
per_item_basis_of_review: Every row ran the same two mechanical checks unconditionally: (1) the fixture-oracle gate — compute() output diffed against the kernel's own existing golden fixtures before any property was trusted, and (2) run-proptests.mjs green (process exit 0). The WU row named 8 of 10 kernels float-sensitive (art-436, art-439, art-447, art-448, art-449, art-450, art-453, art-456) requiring mandatory ULP-boundary forcing, with art-438 and art-452 as stated float:no exceptions. ⚠ FIX-2 CARRY correction made during authoring after direct measurement against each kernel's source: art-450 (model-inventory-entry) and art-453 (model-validation-status) are misclassified in the triage table — art-450's materiality_score/complexity_score are Math.round()'d integers clamped to [0,4] with an integer tier_sum, and art-453's day arithmetic is entirely integer civil-calendar counting (Howard Hinnant's daysFromCivil) — neither has a genuine float-division/threshold-tolerance surface. Both are treated here as float:no-equivalent and carry forced CATEGORICAL boundary cases (integer clamp/tier-sum edges for art-450; calendar-date edges, leap years, cadence-override boundaries for art-453) instead of ULP forcing, matching the pattern FV-PROPFLOOR-SHARD-B12-1 established for its two stated float:no exceptions. The remaining 6 float-sensitive kernels (art-436, art-439, art-447, art-448, art-449, art-456) carry genuine ULP-boundary forcing: ratio/percentage division against fixed thresholds (art-436 capital ratios, art-447 retention percentage, art-456 simplified ETR), unrounded roll-forward addition (art-439, art-448), and a correlation-matrix sum-of-squares under Math.sqrt (art-449). No row beyond these mechanical checks received a separate in-depth human review in this pass — that is exactly the gap human_sign_off.status=PENDING names.
